row.Selected-grade rationale: Documented commercial formulation; traceable manufacturer evidence Filed under TPC / TPEE on 2026-09-28 (m223-what-the-makers-say-it-is), moved from TPE, polymer not stated: copolyester elastomer, "1,3-Benzenedicarboxylic acid 9086-55-9 >97 dimethyl ester polymer with 1,4-butanediol" (D-FIBERLOGY-FIBERFLEX-40D-MSDS-2023, p. 2). Every safety data sheet found (2017, 2022, 2023, 2025) names a copolyester elastomer (CAS 9086-55-9); the 2023 Polish edition is the one with a text layer, and the 2025 English edition (D-FIBERLOGY-FIBERFLEX-40D-SDS-EN) agrees. Its product page calls it TPU; its sheet's density (1.16), melting point (157 to 160 °C) and Shore D 40 are DuPont Hytrel 4056's (1.16, 152 °C). The safety data sheet decides: a TPC. Read by an AI agent (claude-opus-5.5), not a person.
